001package models;
002
003import base.User;
004import enums.Role;
005import research.ResearchPaper;
006import research.ResearchProject;
007import research.Researcher;
008
009import java.util.ArrayList;
010import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
011import java.util.List;
012import java.util.Map;
013
014/**
015 * Teacher user assigned to courses; also acts as a {@link research.Researcher}.
016 */
017public class Teacher extends User implements Researcher {
018    private static final long serialVersionUID = 3L;
019
020    private Map<String, String> marks = new LinkedHashMap<>();
021    private List<String> assignedCourses = new ArrayList<>();
022    private List<Course> assignedCourseObjects = new ArrayList<>();
023    private int hIndex = 0;
024    private List<ResearchPaper> papers = new ArrayList<>();
025    private List<ResearchProject> projects = new ArrayList<>();
026
027    public Teacher(String login, String password, String name) {
028        super(login, hashPassword(password), name, Role.TEACHER);
029    }
030
031    public Map<String, String> getMarks() {
032        if (marks == null) marks = new LinkedHashMap<>();
033        return marks;
034    }
035
036    public List<String> getAssignedCourses() {
037        if (assignedCourses == null) assignedCourses = new ArrayList<>();
038        return assignedCourses;
039    }
040
041    public List<Course> getAssignedCourseObjects() {
042        if (assignedCourseObjects == null) assignedCourseObjects = new ArrayList<>();
043        return assignedCourseObjects;
044    }
045
046    public void setHIndex(int hIndex) { this.hIndex = hIndex; }
047
048    @Override public String getResearcherId() { return getId(); }
049    @Override public String getFullName() { return name; }
050    @Override public int getHIndex() { return hIndex; }
051
052    @Override
053    public List<ResearchPaper> getPapers() {
054        if (papers == null) papers = new ArrayList<>();
055        return papers;
056    }
057
058    @Override
059    public List<ResearchProject> getProjects() {
060        if (projects == null) projects = new ArrayList<>();
061        return projects;
062    }
063
064    @Override
065    public void addPaper(ResearchPaper paper) {
066        if (papers == null) papers = new ArrayList<>();
067        papers.add(paper);
068    }
069
070    @Override
071    public void addProject(ResearchProject project) {
072        if (projects == null) projects = new ArrayList<>();
073        projects.add(project);
074    }
075
076    @Override
077    public String getDetails() {
078        return String.format("Teacher: %s (%s) — h-index %d, %d papers",
079                name, login, hIndex, getPapers().size());
080    }
081}
